brief: Judges an SLA on a cadence and turns changes of verdict into alerts, one when a breach appears and one when it clears.
detail: An SLA judges when asked; the sentinel judges on a cadence and is edge-triggered, which is the honest flap suppression: a breach fires once when it appears and a recovery once when it clears, so an invariant that stays broken does not page you four hundred times. Run it three ways: Check whenever you like, Every and Tick from any loop, or hosted by an agent host through Name_ and Cycle. Every alert also goes out on the engine event bus, perf.breach and perf.clear, and a new breach takes a black-box snapshot of the process. The ledger keeps the newest 256 alerts. Explain and Show raise error R41 today while a rule is breached.
receiver:
oMon = StzPerfMonitor("api")
oDepth = oMon.NewGauge("queue.depth")
oDepth.Set(50)
oSla = StzSla("api")
oSla.ExpectValue("queue.depth").AtMost(100)
o1 = StzPerfSentinel(oSla, oMon)
